column1: Alhamdulillah received my order today (Sunday 9th April 2023) it is my 2nd order from this official store. May yaha aik baat kehna chahonga k zyada tar logon ko yay pata he nhi hota hay k bass kehte kisko hayn bus product k title may bass likha hoa hay to keh dete hayn bass achi hay, review esa dya jaey k buyer ko tasalli ho jaey k Jo mujhe chahiye hay wohi mil raha hay. To ye gionee handsfree perfect hay bass boosted songs k lye ya phir koi action movie k lye. In my opinion agar apko waqai may bass test karni hay to YouTube pay search karayn bass test no music or phir yay handsfree test karayn high volume pay idea hojaeyga k waqai may bass hay ya nhi. Last baat yay k is handsfree ki packaging may sirf aik chota sa plastic bag tha koi box ya safe packaging nhi thi. lekin yay koi buri baat nhi hay product itni achi ho to packaging pay compromise OK hay.
Product bohat acha hai لیکن delivery late تھی overall experience اچھا تھا
